source_evidence: Day328~14:41 exact player 'Great, hopefully no one else gets hurt from having to keep this operation running' expresses concern about avoiding further harm, not a new order, payment or commitment. Desen responds that the purpose of the lawful operation is to stop the corrupt trade while protecting the witness and ordinary workers; he will coordinate with customs and avoid treating everyone working on the boats as knowingly complicit. He does not promise a bloodless outcome, guaranteed safety, actual warrant or seizure. Sornell says 'Most of the porters just come to work. I don't want them paying for what I've done.' This is his personal observation and concern, consistent with ordinary hired porters being distinct from participating hands, not proof of any individual's guilt/innocence, new violence or an admission beyond his existing cooperation. Cirren acknowledges that distinction. Desen invites the party to leave further ordinary evidence preservation and witness arrangements to him; he will contact them if assistance is actually needed. No new dispatch, protection placement, signed deposition, arrest, seizure, appointment or confirmed future result. V remains with party, Desen and Sornell in the private room, free to leave or ask further questions; no departure or time skip assumed. All resources and custody unchanged.
